A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same Rank-GRPO/ConvRec-R1 research work, with complete main text and Appendices A–F. Text extraction and rendered-page comparison support reliable comparison of the equations, figures, tables and examples.

before.justification: v3 reports original ConvRec-R1 training and evaluation results on REDDIT-V2 in Section 3 and on REDIAL in Appendix D.7, including benchmark scores, ablations and training curves.

after.justification: v5 retains these original REDDIT-V2 and REDIAL experiments, including the numerical results in Tables 1–7 and analyses in the appendices.

M1.justification: Both versions retain the same Remap–Reflect–Adjust pipeline, SFT objective, Rank-GRPO updates, reward variants and list-length penalties. The indicator-description wording edits do not establish a changed computational procedure.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate conversational movie recommendation on REDDIT-V2 and REDIAL. Other domains remain discussion-only possibilities in Appendix E; no evaluated dataset or task scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged within the corresponding experiments, including the traditional CRS and prompting baselines, GRPO/GSPO comparisons, and DPO, S-DPO and SPRec comparisons in Appendix D.3.

E3.justification: The dataset splits, backbone configurations, 20-item generation requirement, Recall/NDCG cutoffs, training settings and on-policy/off-policy evaluation procedures are unchanged in Section 3 and Appendices C–D.

E4.justification: The component ablations in Table 2, catalog-drift analysis in Figure 6, penalty sensitivity in Figure 10, larger-model study in Table 7, and qualitative examples in Appendices A.4 and F are all retained unchanged.

E5.justification: The standard-error ranges and significance statements in Tables 1 and 4, and mean/std displays in Figures 1 and 7, are identical. No run-count, seed or uncertainty-estimation information is added or revised.

E6.justification: All numerical results, plotted curves and qualitative outputs are unchanged. For example, Table 1 reports the same Llama-3.2-3B SFT + Rank-GRPO (exp∞) Recall@20 of 0.2368 and NDCG@20 of 0.1283 in both versions.

T1.justification: Section 2.2.2 and Appendix A.1.2 change the indicator condition from I_ic[u,v] = 1 'iff' the items match to 'if' they match. This removes the explicitly stated converse from the formal description; the equations and Appendix B gradient derivations are otherwise unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same contributions and claims about catalog-grounded distillation, rank-level credit assignment and importance weighting, faster convergence, and improved recommendation quality.

C2.justification: Interpretations of training dynamics and catalog drift, qualifications concerning DPO comparisons, computational constraints, and discussion of generalization beyond movies are unchanged in the main text and Appendices D–E.

D1.justification: The metadata-generation instructions, prompts, embedding model, hardware, hyperparameters and inference details in Appendices A, C and D are unchanged. Code/data release statements and their resource-link destinations are also unchanged.

R1.justification: The cited works and research positioning are unchanged, including the distinctions from GRPO, GSPO, Rec-R1, RecLLM-R1 and DPO-based methods. The reference list is identical.

P1.justification: v5 replaces 'iff' with 'if' in two indicator-description passages and updates the arXiv version/date stamp. The remaining wording, section order and appendix organization are unchanged.

P2.justification: Visual changes are confined to the arXiv margin stamp and local text spacing/reflow, particularly below Equation 10 on page 15. Figures 1–10, Tables 1–7, captions, example panels and their placements are unchanged.

improvement.justification: Both versions provide the same methods, experimental evidence, derivations, interpretations and reproducibility information. The revision consists of metadata updates and two small wording edits with incidental reflow. Although replacing 'iff' with 'if' makes the indicator condition less explicit, this localized change does not establish a meaningful overall quality difference.
